decision_rows.reason: The V559 retirement mechanic is reusable as governance only.
Exact solver commitments remain useful when detached from learned heads.
The checkpoint shortcut and harmful flips disqualify learned trajectory energy.
Model receipts can inform future IO boundaries. Factor proposals cannot carry value.
No accepted model factor produced positive held causal value.
The decomposed energy and checker router branch never cleared its gate.
The controller mechanics are reusable without factor-learning claims.
Chronological learning executed, but held-future benefit did not open.
Support controls are reusable. They do not prove learning value.
The audit pattern is reusable, but it confirms claim ineligibility.
ARC prefix energy did not align with later progress, so policy edits stay closed.
No authenticated local special-hardware evidence supports a speed claim.
The capstone handoff is frozen as the V561 boundary evidence.

retired_scope_definition.boundary: Retired scopes may appear only as evidence or controls, not V561 claim inputs.

Claim FPGA, TSU, Z1, or Kona acceleration from context only.
Treat lifecycle controls as a held-future learning claim.
